name: Recipes
summary: Find recipes and cook from them
description: Search NYT Cooking recipes on your own recipe server and cook from them with the keypad: change the servings and the amounts follow, and tick off ingredients and steps as you go. Set up with the server's address and token.
author: thooton

changes.text: NYT Cooking through the recipe server.
A read-only recipe finder with a pluggable source.
Revise catalog descriptions and retire Book Recs.
A recipe box for the XP3, with servings that scale the amounts and ingredients and steps to tick off while cooking.
